name: DPRK Job Applicant Fraud Detection Service

mentions.name: DPRK Job Applicant Fraud Detection Service
mentions.description: A free service that detects fraudulent North Korean (D.P.R.K) job applicants, flagging fake candidates in hiring pipelines. The author reports the fraud scheme has been going on since at least 2018 and has flagged thousands of such applicants.
mentions.problem: Fraudulent D.P.R.K job applicants targeting hiring processes, an ongoing issue since at least 2018 with thousands of such applicants flagged.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a free service to detect fraudulent D.P.R.K job applicants. It has been going on since 2018 at least and I have flagged thousands of such applicants.
